name: ramdiag
description: Diagnostic for stock 1.2.0: fills RAM regions no firmware code refers to with a pattern once the Pattern screen runs, then reports how much stays untouched and the heap's high-water mark (Config > Project Settings > RAM diag, and ramdiag.txt). Install on its own: it uses the same hook sites as humanize.

branches.note: Config menu constructor: Project Settings folder, room for 10 items -> 11
Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); then resets ramdiag's state and adds the RAM diag folder

words.note: Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_rd_pattern_update (fill once, report every minute)
Config screen vtable: update method 0x600c6475 -> mt_rd_config_update (scan, report)
